description: Intended differences between mailroom_dojo.statistics and llm-dojo-scoring 0.30.1 (commit 23f8234c) on statistics_cases.jsonl. Each entry: case (corpus case id), function, reason, new_outcome ({"result": ...} or {"raises": type, "message": text}). Every entry is an invalid input. test_differential_statistics_parity.py fails on a difference not listed here and on a listed one that no longer occurs or now gives another outcome. See packages/dojo/docs/score-changelog.md.
